title: Cross-material purpose-transfer and direct timing pilot
rationale: Before building the longer production-like daily/seasonal panel, test whether the P1 S4/G4 signal transfers beyond B01/B14 under fresh dynamic histories and directly time the purpose-specific implementations against a Reference Richards route.

SURF_P.source: ROM-PURPOSE P3 preregistered fresh surface histories

GW_LB.source: ROM-PURPOSE P3 preregistered fresh groundwater histories

reference.solver: SWAP5 Reference Richards legacy binding via frozen ROM-PURPOSE harness
reference.qualification: O0/O2 identity required for target on each material/purpose; R128-vs-R256 difference retained as numerical-resolution comparator, not application tolerance

regime_rule.EVENT_SENSITIVE: any GW sign mismatch, reversal sequence mismatch or nonzero reversal timing error
regime_rule.ROBUST_RELATIVE: qualified candidate, no discrete event/timing mismatch, and complete metric vector is componentwise no worse than the R128-vs-R256 numerical comparator
regime_rule.APPROXIMATE_TRANSFER: qualified and no discrete event/timing mismatch but does not reach numerical comparator
regime_rule.STRUCTURALLY_UNRELIABLE: candidate or Reference not numerically qualified

performance_firewall: Ratios are valid only within the same GitHub Actions job/runner and are implementation measurements, not portable speedups.
scope_firewall: P2A is a cross-material short-horizon transfer pilot, not the final production-like daily/seasonal panel.
No targeted repair until aggregate P2A result is available.
